t: Mine, and carry home what hands and packs can hold.
Walk all of it. A full map comes home as a Chart card.
Hunt every creature and break the nest. It breeds while it stands.
Find the caged figure and carry them home to join you.
Carry wood out and light braziers. Lit ground is not forgotten. A brazier burns 6 days.
Find the sealed cache and bring back what is in it.
